itm_position_eligible_exists.meaning: a long ITM position eligible for force exercise exists

tick_twap_deviation_under_513.meaning: staleness check ensures deviation of currentTick from TWAP is under 513 ticks

settlement_uses_manipulable_spot.meaning: force exercise settlement value is computed from a spot price that can be atomically manipulated within the staleness threshold

funds_stolen_from_position_holders.meaning: direct theft of funds from position holders occurs

claims.scope: Direct theft of funds from position holders:

preconditions.text: A long ITM position eligible for force exercise exists.; The staleness check only ensures deviation of currentTick from TWAP is under 513 ticks (~5%).
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: Force exercise settlement value must not be computed from a spot price that can be atomically manipulated within the staleness threshold.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Direct theft of funds from position holders:
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: Force exercise settlement value is the observable whose manipulation is claimed.
The staleness threshold check is the only guard against spot manipulation.

limitations: Settlement value and theft outcome are represented as grounded Booleans because the report gives no numeric operands for the value relation.

The 513-tick / ~5% threshold is captured as a Boolean staleness-check fact rather than a numeric comparison because the report does not state the TWAP value or tick arithmetic needed for a numeric predicate.
